title: Play AC Online letters file (api 2)
description: Letter templates a mod command (send_letter) mails through the mailbox, named "<mod id>:<letter id>". The game wraps the body at the paper's width in its own font and refuses one that needs more than 6 lines, and refuses a present that is money, turnips, a ticket, a grab bag, a fossil or not an item. Either scope. Generated from the mod API spec (https://playaconline.com/schemas/api.json). Do not edit by hand. Reference: https://playaconline.com/modding/reference/files/

header.description: 1 to 24 characters besides at most one {player}, where the name goes. No line break. Plain text: printable ASCII, no { or }.

body.description: 1 to 192 characters on at most 6 lines. Plain text: printable ASCII, no { or }.

footer.description: The sign-off at the foot of the letter, 1 to 32 characters. Plain text: printable ASCII, no { or }. The mailbox list shows only its first 8 characters unless the letter has a sender.

sender.description: Optional: the name in the mailbox list, 1 to 8 characters (the list has room for 8). Without it the list shows the footer's first 8 characters, so "The Lantern Keepers" reads "The Lant". The letter itself always signs with the whole footer. Plain text: printable ASCII, no { or }.
